newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan plans T$15 bln T-bill auction on July 22. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Taiwan plans T$15 bln T-bill auction on July 22. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]

text.p: Taiwan will auction T$15 billion in 126-day treasury bills on July 22 the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
(Corrects date in headline and first paragraph from July 23 to July 22.)
The issue date is July 23, the ministry said.

The ministry on Tuesday auctioned off T$11.85 billion treasury bills, one of several recent issues seen by private analysts as government efforts to curb market liquidity amid a torrid stock market bull run.
